pull.title: wallet, migration: Skip legacy wallet records rather than erasing them, and drop unused record erase functions
pull.body: When migrating a legacy wallet, we can skip the records in `MigrateToSQLite` that we would delete later on during migration. These records are specifically all of the legacy wallet records, and transaction records. The legacy wallet records are replaced with descriptor records produced during migration, and transaction records are already being rewritten by migration, so not writing them in the first place is also fine. This allows us to remove several database record erase functions, specifically EraseTx and EraseRecords.

events.message:
wallet: Skip copy of legacy wallet records rather than erasing

Instead of erasing legacy wallet records and tx records from the
migrated database, skip copying these records in the first place.
wallet: Remove unused RemoveTxs and EraseTx
wallet, walletdb: Remove unused DeleteRecordsWithDB and EraseRecords

walletdb: Make HasLegacyRecords static

HasLegacyRecords is only used by LoadLegacyWalletRecords to check
whether a descriptor wallet has any legacy wallet records. This does not
require a CWallet, and is no longer called by anything outside of
walletdb.cpp.
